cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: Demand: P↓->Qd↑ (law); Determinants: income, tastes, related goods, expectations, #buyers

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: Supply: P↑->Qs↑; Determinants: input prices, technology, expectations, #sellers, taxes/subsidies

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: Equilibrium: Qd=Qs; Shortage: P<P* -> Qd>Qs; Surplus: P>P* -> Qs>Qd

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: PED = %DeltaQd/%DeltaP; elastic (>1), inelastic (<1), unitary (=1); factors: substitutes, necessity, time, %income

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: YED: normal (>0), inferior (<0); XED: substitutes (>0), complements (<0); PES: time, spare capacity

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: Surplus: CS = area under D above P; PS = area above S below P; Deadweight loss from intervention

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: Market structures: PC (many, homogeneous, free entry); Monopoly (one, barriers); MC (many, differentiated); Oligopoly (few, interdependence)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Microeconomics and Markets
cards.back: Labour: D = MRP; S = workers; Wage = MRP = MRC in PC; Monopsony: MRC > S; Unions: collective bargaining
